verdict.rationale: Consensus generates AI-driven insights directly within the product: semantic search/synthesis, the Consensus Meter aggregating study verdicts, PICO extraction, study-design classification, literature review synthesis, and a research agent chaining citation crawling/DOI lookup, all with inline citations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of insight quality and no user-facing UI screenshots/reviews confirming the experience beyond vendor docs.
